description: Per-world display names for party jobs. struktured 2026-08-09: 'party CHARACTER NAMES should change from one overworld to another' — his example Fighter -> Mall Cop (suburban). Register is deflationary: the archetype survives the world shift and loses its dignity. Same person, re-skinned by the world's logic. Consistent with each job's voice in job_personas.json.
_world_key_warning: Keys are WORLD THEMES, not map ids. W5 is 'futuristic' here; the codebase also calls that world 'digital' in some places (5 uses vs 2) and its map id is 'futuristic_overworld'. A resolver keying on the wrong vocabulary silently misses W5 and falls back to the base name — which looks like a design choice, not a bug. Normalize to these six keys and assert every one resolves.
_scope: Starter jobs only (5 of 15). The 9 advanced/meta jobs are debug-gated and deliberately absent — absence must mean 'use the base name from jobs.json' by an explicit branch, not by a lookup that happens to miss.
